facts.value: Economics studies how societies manage scarce resources to produce, distribute, and consume goods and services.
Economics studies how individuals, businesses, and governments allocate scarce resources.
The two main branches of economics are microeconomics and macroeconomics.
Economics focuses on production, distribution, consumption, and efficiency.
Economic indicators such as GDP and the Consumer Price Index (CPI) are used to measure economic performance and trends.
Economics is a social science that studies how individuals, businesses, governments, and nations make decisions about allocating limited resources.
It examines how goods and services are produced, distributed, and consumed, and how these decisions affect society, businesses, and government policy.
